title: Sculk-powered stacking raid farm announced
summary: A new high-speed stacking raid farm based on sculk sensors was announced.
description: The SinFul Team prepared a new stacking raid farm design using sculk sensors for its next major farm release.

body.text: A new high-speed stacking raid farm based on sculk sensors was announced as the next video.
The design was created by the SinFul Team, formed by Ecliptic and TheySix.
